summary: Server only. One piece of a TabletopDeck: a playing card, or one of your own pieces. It is in the stack, in a player's hand, on a pile, or in the air while it flies.

id.summary: The piece's id, as the deck's pieces list gave it: a playing card's rank and suit ('AS', 'TH', '7C', 'RJ' and 'BJ' for the jokers), or your own. Its models are <id>.cgf (lower case) in the deck's models folder.

rank.summary: A playing card's rank: 'A', '2' to '9', 'T' (ten), 'J', 'Q' or 'K'; null for a joker or a piece of your own.

suit.summary: A playing card's suit: 'S' (spades), 'H' (hearts), 'D' (diamonds) or 'C' (clubs); null for a joker or a piece of your own.
suit.example: const follows = piece.suit === top.suit || piece.rank === top.rank;
suit.exampleLua: local follows = piece.suit == top.suit or piece.rank == top.rank
suit.exampleCs: var follows = piece.Suit == top.Suit || piece.Rank == top.Rank;

place.summary: Where it is: 'stack', 'hand', 'pile', or 'moving' while it flies.
place.exampleLua:
if piece.place == "hand" then
  print(tostring(piece.holder.nickname) .. " holds it")
end

holder.summary: The player whose hand it is in, else null.

pile.summary: The name of the pile it lies on, else null.

faceUp.summary: Whether it lies face up on its pile (everyone sees its face). A piece in a hand shows its face to its holder only, unless the hand is revealed.
faceUp.exampleLua:
local top = deck:pile("table")[1]
local shown = top ~= nil and top.faceUp

selected.summary: Whether its holder selected it (raised out of the fan) to play.
selected.exampleLua:
local first = deck:hand(player)[1]
local ready = first ~= nil and first.selected

data.summary: Your own data on the piece (a value, who played it), kept by the deck's save(). You can change it or assign a new object.
